task.title: Complete the new UI design-system implementation across the renderer
task.objective: Finish the Hologram design-system migration started by the earlier campaign: harden the shared token spine (status rgb triplets, --awkit-shadow-lg, --font-mono, a theme-adaptive categorical chart-series family), retire the legacy --awkit-purple aliases, remove provably dead legacy CSS families, fix the SessionsManager invalid var()+alpha status-pill bug and migrate its px literals onto tokens, move the ReportsFailures categorical palette onto --awkit-chart-* tokens, bound the documented exceptions (avatar identity art, connector user-content presets), and add a fail-closed verify:design-tokens verifier with static CSS contract checks plus a real-Electron light/dark proof; verify affected GUI verifiers and repository gates; reconcile project state; commit coherently to main; push normally.

compatibility: Pure presentation migration: no IPC, persistence, workflow, runner, recorder or licensing behavior changes.
Preserve persisted connector color presets as user content (hex is part of the saved-data contract).
Do not disable, hide or remove any working control.
offline: No new dependency; the verifier reuses the existing Playwright Electron harness.

acceptance.description: Every painted color in global.css resolves through a token (avatar identity art explicitly bounded), no referenced custom property is undefined, and the categorical chart palette is defined, distinct and theme-adaptive in both themes.

SessionsManager status pills paint the soft status fill in both themes (the invalid var()+alpha concatenation is gone), its px literals resolve through spacing/type/radius tokens, and the Reports categorical palettes reference --awkit-chart-*/accent tokens instead of hex literals.
The dead workflow-stage/flow-node/scenario-chain/stage-badge/mini-map/node-handle/workflow-board families and the --awkit-purple aliases are removed with zero live references.
verify:design-tokens fails on an undefined-var mutation and on a rule-body color-literal mutation, and passes 29/29 on the real implementation.
awkit-44eu is closed and exported, project state and the roadmap tracker pin are reconciled, the implementation is committed to main and pushed normally, and the worktree ends clean.

evidence.note: 29/29: static contract (undefined-var, rule-body literal, chart palette parity/distinctness/theme-adaptivity, spine tokens in both themes) plus real-Electron light/dark proof of the token spine and the Sessions status pill in both themes.
